messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High error rate detected for /v1/generate (model-route: redwood/gpt-xxl-v3-canary). Please respond in #incidents.
deploy-bot: Deploy event: `model-service canary` started by @sam at 2026-03-15T09:04:28Z. Artifact: weights@sha256:abcd1234 -> label v3-canary
emma (oncall): @sam putting eyes on this. what metrics are spiking?
leo (sre): 5xx rate on canaries up to 22% in last 3m. Latency also up ~30%. Canary cluster nodes showing `tokenizer_error` in logs.
sam (runtime): Confirming, the rollout included a new weightset + tokenizer pair. Automatic compatibility check passed, but canary logs show `TokenizerChecksumMismatch` when parsing certain prefixes.
olivier (ml): That's consistent with a tokenizer vocab reorder. Might be wrong tokenizer artifact packaged with weights. Did pipeline pin tokenizer sha?
maria (cust-eng): Any customer impact? Nora reported a handful of customers with degraded responses.
nora (support): We have 6 active tickets from larger customers — some user outputs are gibberish, others returning `500` or truncated responses. Estimated traffic impacted ~3-6% depending on route.
emma (oncall): Ok first stabilization action: flip canary routing to fallback model variant (stable-v2) for all traffic hitting canary route. Sam can you execute kill-switch/route override and confirm?
sam (runtime): Doing now. Pushing override to routing policy: `curl -X POST https://console/api/routes/override -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood/gpt-xxl-v2-stable","policy":"force"}'` — applied.
deploy-bot: Routing override accepted. New policy: `force stable-v2` for route /v1/generate. Rollout controller: affected shards 4/4.
leo (sre): Error rate dropped to 1.1% within 90s. Latency back to baseline. :white_check_mark:
elma (oncall): typo: emma*
emma (oncall): :sweat_smile: thanks. Logging mitigation steps in incident doc (link: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-3004)
olivier (ml): Can we confirm it's tokenizer mismatch and not weight sharding issue? Logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:06:12Z runtime[canary-3]: ERROR TokenizerChecksumMismatch expected=sha256:ef12 got=sha256:aa77
2026-03-15T09:06:12Z runtime[canary-3]: WARN Failed to decode prefix, fallback to error path
2026-03-15T09:06:13Z model-loader[canary-3]: INFO weights loaded: weights@sha256:abcd1234
```
sam (runtime): Pipeline replay confirms mismatch: the build step bundled tokenizer sha `aa77` with weights `abcd1234` but canonical mapping expects `ef12`. The verifier in CI missed it because the checksum file was stale in the artifact registry.
emma (oncall): Impact summary for Slack: 5xx spike on canaries only, routed traffic to stable-v2, estimated customer-requests impacted 3-6%, no full customer outages. Paging severity: P2 -> moving to P1 during active mitigation then back to P2 for followup.
maria (cust-eng): Informing affected customers. I'll post an update in the support thread with mitigation actions and ETA for fix (ETA 2-4h).
sam (runtime): Plan: 1) rollback canary tag to previous known-good artifact 2) fix artifact registry checksum & re-run verification 3) redeploy new canary with correct tokenizer sha. Rolling back canary weights now.
deploy-bot: Rollback command issued by @sam: `rdctl rollout cancel --env=canary --artifact=weights@sha256:abcd1234 && rdctl rollout apply --artifact=weights@sha256:prevgood` — rollout controller acked.
leo (sre): Monitor: canary 5xx down to 0.4%, latency stable. :thumbsup:
emma (oncall): Handoff: I need to go. @leo you're next oncall for mitigation / followup. Please coordinate with @olivier and @sam for root cause. I'll create the initial incident timeline and assign postmortem to @olivier.
leo (sre): Taking over. Oncall notes: created page INC-3004, added tags: tokenizer, deployment, artifact-registry. Next steps: reproduce locally, identify why verifier used stale checksum, add guard.
olivier (ml): I'll look at the model packaging pipeline. Hypothesis: a race in packaging job where tokenizer upload lagged and checksum file referenced previous tokenizer. Will add end-to-end artifact manifest check.
sam (runtime): Temporary config to prevent automatic canary promotion until manual signoff is re-enabled: `featureflag: canary_auto_promote = false` — setting now.
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: `canary_auto_promote=false` by @sam.
emma (oncall): Closing loop for customer comms: @maria please add note about rollback and that we're scheduling a controlled redeploy after verification.
maria (cust-eng): Will do. Sending update now. :envelope_with_arrow:
nora (support): Tickets updated. Customers appreciate quick mitigation. A few asked for a postmortem email.
leo (sre): Post-incident actions (short term): 1) enforce artifact manifest manifestization 2) add CI check to compare tokenizer and weights checksum 3) add runbook step to flip routing and rollback quicker. Assigning tasks: @sam (runtime) CI fix, @olivier (ml) packaging fix, @leo (sre) runbook update, @maria (cust-eng) customer comms.
olivier (ml): Assigning myself to postmortem lead. I'll draft RCA and include packaging timeline and proposed fixes.
emma (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'll update leadership and mark incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update in the incident doc in 2h or when redeploy completes.
